title: Layered Architecture Technical Reference
readerIntent: Map a technical artifact to its responsibility and validation expectations.
owner: Nodics modular runtime and all module owners
summary: The technical hierarchy is consistent across modules even when a small module does not require every optional layer.

sections.heading: Artifact map
items: config: properties, definitions, presets, and lifecycle scripts.
src/schema and src/search: governed data and query contracts.
src/service and src/facade: owned behavior and use-case coordination.
src/controller and src/router: transport adaptation and API declarations.
src/pipelines and src/interceptors: ordered processing and explicit lifecycle extensions.
src/event: event declarations, listeners, and handlers.
src/lib and src/utils: narrow reusable mechanics.
src/status: stable success and error definitions.
test: focused contracts plus integration and regression evidence.

sections.heading: Dependency direction
paragraphs: Higher-level use-case and transport layers depend on owned services and contracts. Provider adapters implement provider-neutral framework contracts. Business modules do not reach around those contracts to bind directly to infrastructure clients.
